notes.title: Turret Sector V1.3 Released
notes.notes:
Just to let you know, Turret Sector has been updated to V1.3. This version includes the following minor changes -

- Enemy health bars toggle, automatically defaults to your last chosen setting.
Within the Menu's options you can decide whether or not you want the enemy health bar to be displayed.

- The in-game guide now shows all games controls. These controls are also displayed in a Readme.txt file, which is included within the games folder.

More updates are planned, if you wish to provide feedback or report a bug, please do so at [b]kittikstudio@gmail.com[/b].

notes.title: Turret Sector V1.2 Released
notes.notes:
[h1]Major changes in V1.2 include -[/h1]

- An overhaul of how turrets are upgraded. Instead of checking how many kills a turret has, upgrading is determined by the amount of damage a turret has inflicted.

This allows for all turrets to have an equal chance of upgrading, instead of later turrets, which attack weakened enemies.

- Enemy health bars have been added. These can be toggled on/off by pressing 'H'.

[h1]Minor changes in V1.2 include -[/h1]

- Badly damaged enemies emit black smoke, showing that they are close to being destroyed.

- Scanning Turrets have been renamed to Basic Turrets, to remove any misunderstanding about what they do.

- Environment colliders have been updated.

More updates are planned, if you wish to provide feedback or report a bug, please do so at [b]kittikstudio@gmail.com[/b].

notes.title: Turret Sector 1.1 Released
notes.notes:
Just to let you know, that Turret Sector has been updated to V1.1. In this latest patch the following changes include -

- Animated directional arrows  now cycle from enemy spawn points
- Zooming out distance has been increased

The changes are minimal and should download in no time. Should you encounter any problems downloading the updates, I suggest you first try restarting Steam.
